## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| All admin endpoints require site admin privileges via reqSiteAdmin() middleware | authorization | tokenRequiresScopes(AccessTokenScopeCategoryAdmin), reqToken(), reqSiteAdmin() |
| Admin context (ownerID=0, repoID=0) allows editing any runner regardless of ownership | business_logic | ownerID == 0 && repoID == 0 |
| UpdateRunner requires Disabled field to be non-nil | validation | form.Disabled == nil |
| SetRunnerDisabled is a no-op if the runner already has the desired disabled state | business_logic | runner.IsDisabled == isDisabled |
| Disabling/enabling a runner triggers IncreaseTaskVersion to notify runners of config changes | business_logic | Runner disabled state changes |
